Can we consolidate all manager writeups into a single spreadsheet and then send the redacted versions to People Ops for archival?

Attached is a starter template I reused last cycle (Q2_coaching_template.xlsx) and an example exec summary stub — please review and flag anything that should stay out of the shared doc. I want the consolidated set by EOD Friday so I can review with execs next Monday.

- Laura: capture direct reports' stretch goals + 1 coaching action each (use tab per manager)
- Neha: please prepare a short note for any employees with performance guardrails or flagged risks; mark them PRIVATE in your sheet and don't include in the shared drive preview
- Elena (People Ops): can you confirm the retention label we should attach and if you need signed acknowledgement for any sensitive cases?

Thanks — will block a 30-min slot for review once we have the consolidated sheet.

Marcus
Director, Infrastructure

Subject: Re: Performance guardrails & Q2 coaching plan — manager notes consolidation

Thanks for the note, Marcus — happy to help. Quick guidance from People Ops: we prefer a two-file flow for audits and privacy:

1) Consolidated, redacted manager summary (shared drive — non-sensitive): capture goals, coaching actions, and progress metrics.
2) Privileged details (encrypted, access-restricted in vendor vault): cases that mention medical leaves, protected characteristics, or potential PIP wording. Label these files as PRIVATE and only list an abstract (e.g., "Manager A — performance risk, summary sent to People Ops") in the consolidated sheet.

Retention & acknowledgement:
- Retention label: "HR-Performance-2yr" — we will need retention metadata attached before archival.
- For designations that could lead to formal action (PIP or termination), please include the short internal memo and cc our secure mailbox people-ops-vendor@externalhr.example.com.

I attached a small checklist and redaction rules (see drive link). If you prefer, we can sign off on the final consolidated doc and apply the retention label on our side.

Best,
Elena Vargas
People Ops (Vendor)

Attachments: redaction-checklist.pdf (pdf)
